_comment: unpaired-v3: unpaired-v2 with the harmonic dimension weighted zero. Its three
terms are measured on the longest steady note the pitch tracker finds; two
passages through the same settings differ on it by a median 0.56 to 0.88,
while the same passage through clean-to-driven settings moves it 0.05 to
0.38, and a DI and its own amp track picked the same note on 7 of 14 takes
from unpaired-v3' in docs/tone-matching-plan.md). Within one passage, as in
a paired reamp, it does follow the settings, so paired-v2 keeps it.
Its own file, as the -v2 ones: earlier files stay byte-identical.

unpaired-v3.description: A commercial recording against a render. As unpaired-v2, without the harmonic dimension: on played material its note, and so its odd/even ratio, HNR and fizz, follow the passage far more than the amp.
